integrity: All numerical checks were run against the standalone verifier. The analytic proof establishes the all-order theorem. No claim of independent certification or publication priority beyond the inspected evidence.
scientific_limitations: Final-step entrywise positivity for unweighted complete multipartite graph Laplacians and degree-p Taylor heat polynomials only; not intermediate-stage positivity or arbitrary graphs. Publication-priority risk persists because one relevant specialist article was available as abstract but not in full text. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Parity law for Taylor heat positivity on complete multipartite graphs
